item.title: Poor road conditions, 17th September
item.description:
I am reporting the poor general state of my road, it appears over the years various potholes have been filled and refilled however the whole road is very uneven with big dips throughout and manhole covers which are quite exposed. It’s like I’m off roading across rocky terrain everytime I drive down it . I can hear cars and vans squeeking and bashing down the road because of the poor quality of the terrain. I don’t think the road has been resurfaced for so so many years and it really shows not only is it uncomfortable to drive down and is likely damaging cars but also it looks truly dreadful. I wonder whether please may be considered for resurfacing, i know myself and my neighbours would really appreciate it.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 48, Keynsham Street, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
